ex.en: Should I buy a wireless mouse?
ex.zh: 要不要買無線滑鼠呢？

ex.en: The café offers free wireless internet.
ex.zh: 這家咖啡店提供免費無線網路。

ex.en: I made a cash withdrawal at the ATM.
ex.zh: 我在提款機領了現金。

ex.en: There is a small fee for each withdrawal.
ex.zh: 每次提款都要收一點手續費。

withdrawal.en: the act of taking money out of a bank account

ex.en: His withdrawal from the race surprised everyone.
ex.zh: 他退出比賽讓大家都很意外。

ex.en: The company announced its withdrawal from the European market.
ex.zh: 這家公司宣布退出歐洲市場。

withdrawal.en: the act of leaving a place, group or activity

ex.en: If these drugs are stopped abruptly, then some withdrawal symptoms may occur.
ex.zh: 如果突然停藥，可能會出現一些戒斷症狀。

ex.en: Headaches are a common withdrawal symptom for coffee drinkers.
ex.zh: 頭痛是常喝咖啡的人常見的戒斷症狀。

withdrawal.en: the unpleasant physical and mental effects of stopping a drug that you were used to taking

ex.en: Spend your money wisely.
ex.zh: 錢要花得明智。

ex.en: She wisely decided to wait for the next offer.
ex.zh: 她明智地決定等待下一個工作機會。

wisely.en: in a way that shows good judgment

ex.en: She showed a willingness to learn new skills.
ex.zh: 她展現出學習新技能的意願。

ex.en: We appreciate your willingness to help.
ex.zh: 感謝你願意幫忙。

willingness.en: the quality of being ready to do something when asked

ex.en: The jury's guilty verdict gave rise to widespread debate.
ex.zh: 陪審團的有罪判決引發了廣泛的爭論。

ex.en: There was widespread panic after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震後民眾普遍感到恐慌。

ex.en: The use of mobile payment is now widespread.
ex.zh: 行動支付現在已經很普遍。

widespread.en: found or happening in many places or among many people

ex.en: The city plans to widen the road.
ex.zh: 市政府計畫拓寬這條道路。

ex.en: The gap between rich and poor has widened.
ex.zh: 貧富差距擴大了。

ex.en: We want to widen our customer base.
ex.zh: 我們想擴大客群。

widen.en: to become broader or larger, or to make something broader or larger

ex.en: He was accused of withholding information.
ex.zh: 他被指控隱瞞資訊。

ex.en: The client withheld payment until the work was finished.
ex.zh: 客戶扣住款項，直到工作完成才付。

withhold.en: to refuse to give something, or to keep information secret

ex.en: Taxes are withheld from your monthly salary.
ex.zh: 稅款會從你的月薪中預扣。

ex.en: The employer must withhold income tax.
ex.zh: 雇主必須代扣所得稅。

withhold.en: to take part of someone's pay for tax before paying them

ex.en: He is remarkable for his wisdom.
ex.zh: 他以過人的智慧著稱。

ex.en: Philosophy is the love of wisdom.
ex.zh: 哲學就是對智慧的熱愛。

ex.en: Thank you for sharing your wisdom with us.
ex.zh: 謝謝你和我們分享你的智慧。

wisdom.en: the ability to make good decisions based on knowledge and experience

wisdom.zh: conventional wisdom：一般的看法、普遍觀念

ex.en: Conventional wisdom says you should buy a house early.
ex.zh: 一般認為應該早點買房。

ex.en: Contrary to conventional wisdom, small teams can work faster.
ex.zh: 和普遍看法相反，小團隊反而能做得更快。

wisdom.en: an idea that most people accept as true

ex.en: The train from Geneva will arrive at the station.
ex.zh: 從日內瓦來的火車即將進站。

ex.en: If I don't do it now, I never will.
ex.zh: 如果我現在不做，就永遠不會做了。

ex.en: I will send you the details tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天會把細節寄給你。

will.en: used to talk about things that are going to happen in the future

ex.en: Will you close the door, please?
ex.zh: 可以請你把門關上嗎？

ex.en: Will you help me with this box?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我搬這個箱子嗎？

will.en: used to politely ask someone to do something

ex.en: She has a strong will to succeed.
ex.zh: 她有強烈的成功意志。

ex.en: He lost the will to keep trying.
ex.zh: 他失去了繼續嘗試的意志。

will.en: the strong determination to do what you want

ex.en: My grandfather left me his house in his will.
ex.zh: 爺爺在遺囑中把房子留給我。

ex.en: Have you made a will yet?
ex.zh: 你立遺囑了嗎？

will.en: a legal paper saying who gets your money and things after you die

ex.en: I couldn't have done it without you. Thank you.
ex.zh: 沒有你我做不到，謝謝你。

ex.en: Today no one can imagine a life without television.
ex.zh: 現在沒有人能想像沒有電視的生活。

without.en: not having or not using something or someone

ex.en: He took my umbrella without so much as asking.
ex.zh: 他連問都沒問就拿走了我的雨傘。

ex.en: He left without saying goodbye.
ex.zh: 他沒說再見就走了。

without.en: used to show that one action happens with no other action done at the same time or before

ex.en: It goes without saying that money cannot buy happiness.
ex.zh: 不用說，錢買不到快樂。

ex.en: It goes without saying that health is above wealth.
ex.zh: 不用說，健康勝過財富。

without.en: used to say that something is so clear that it needs no explanation

ex.en: I promise to return this videotape within a week.
ex.zh: 我保證一週內把這卷錄影帶還回來。

ex.en: I'll be back within a couple of hours.
ex.zh: 我兩個小時內就會回來。

ex.en: Within one month of going abroad, he became sick.
ex.zh: 出國不到一個月，他就生病了。

within.en: before a certain length of time has passed

ex.en: Please stay within the budget.
ex.zh: 請不要超出預算。

ex.en: The hotel is within walking distance of the station.
ex.zh: 飯店離車站走路就到得了。

within.en: not more than a certain distance, amount or limit

wish.zh: 但願、真希望（與事實相反）

ex.en: I wish you had told me the truth then.
ex.zh: 真希望你當時就告訴我實話。

ex.en: I wish I could break the habit of smoking.
ex.zh: 真希望我能戒掉菸癮。

ex.en: How I wished I could drive a car!
ex.zh: 我多希望自己會開車啊！

wish.en: to want something to be true when it is not or cannot be

ex.en: I am wishing every high school student good luck on their exams!
ex.zh: 祝所有高中生考試順利！

ex.en: We wish you a merry Christmas.
ex.zh: 祝你聖誕快樂。

wish.en: to say that you hope someone will have something good

ex.en: Children often send letters to Santa with their wishes.
ex.zh: 孩子們常寫信給聖誕老人，說出自己的願望。

ex.en: Best wishes for your new job!
ex.zh: 祝你新工作一切順利！

wish.en: something that you want to happen, or a hope for someone's happiness

ex.en: If you wish to cancel, please call us.
ex.zh: 如果您想取消，請來電告知。

ex.en: You may leave early if you wish.
ex.zh: 如果你想的話，可以提早離開。

wish.en: to want to do something, in a polite or formal way

ex.en: I went to the hospital to see my wife.
ex.zh: 我去醫院看我太太。

ex.en: He had no idea why his wife left him.
ex.zh: 他不知道為什麼妻子離開他。

ex.en: He told his wife not to buy on impulse.
ex.zh: 他叫妻子不要衝動購物。

wife.en: the woman that a man is married to

ex.en: I left the window open all through the night.
ex.zh: 我整晚都開著窗。

ex.en: It looks like rain. We had better shut the windows.
ex.zh: 看起來要下雨了，我們最好把窗戶關上。

ex.en: She closed all the windows in the room.
ex.zh: 她把房間裡的窗戶全關上了。

window.en: an opening in a wall with glass in it that lets in light and air

ex.en: Click the button to open a new window.
ex.zh: 按這個按鈕開啟新視窗。

ex.en: You can open the file in a new browser window.
ex.zh: 你可以在新的瀏覽器視窗中開啟檔案。

window.en: a framed area on a computer screen that shows a program or file

ex.en: The river is the widest in Europe.
ex.zh: 這條河是歐洲最寬的。

ex.en: The hallway needs to be wide enough for a wheelchair.
ex.zh: 走廊要寬到輪椅能通過。

wide.en: measuring a long distance from one side to the other

ex.en: The store offers a wide range of products.
ex.zh: 這家店提供各式各樣的產品。

ex.en: She has a wide variety of interests.
ex.zh: 她的興趣非常廣泛。

wide.en: including many different kinds of things

ex.en: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
ex.zh: 婚前要睜大眼睛，婚後半閉著眼。

ex.en: The door was wide open.
ex.zh: 門大開著。

ex.en: The strong wind indicates that a storm is coming.
ex.zh: 強風顯示暴風雨就要來了。

ex.en: Besides the rain, we experienced heavy winds.
ex.zh: 除了下雨，我們還遇到了強風。

ex.en: The ship made slow progress against the strong wind.
ex.zh: 這艘船逆著強風緩慢前進。

wind.en: air that moves outside, sometimes with strong force

ex.en: Chongqing is a hilly city with winding streets.
ex.zh: 重慶是一座山城，街道彎彎曲曲。

ex.en: The road winds through the mountains.
ex.zh: 這條路蜿蜒穿過群山。

wind.en: to follow a path with many turns, not a straight line

ex.en: I like to wind down with a book at night.
ex.zh: 我晚上喜歡看書放鬆一下。

ex.en: The company is winding down its old business.
ex.zh: 公司正在逐步收掉舊業務。

wind.en: to relax after work, or to slowly come to an end

ex.en: There is a bottle of wine on the table.
ex.zh: 桌上有一瓶葡萄酒。

ex.en: Do you like French wines?
ex.zh: 你喜歡法國葡萄酒嗎？

ex.en: There's a bottle of white wine in the refrigerator.
ex.zh: 冰箱裡有一瓶白酒。

wine.en: an alcoholic drink made from grapes

ex.en: He went to Africa to see wild animals.
ex.zh: 他去非洲看野生動物。

ex.en: My hobby is taking pictures of wild flowers.
ex.zh: 我的嗜好是拍野花。

wild.en: living or growing in nature, not looked after by people

ex.en: Dennis can be very wild sometimes.
ex.zh: 丹尼斯有時候會很瘋狂。

ex.en: The fans went wild when the band appeared.
ex.zh: 樂團一出現，歌迷就瘋狂了。

ex.en: These birds are rarely seen in the wild.
ex.zh: 這些鳥在野外很少見。

ex.en: Few pandas still live in the wild.
ex.zh: 仍生活在野外的貓熊已經不多了。

wild.en: natural places where animals live free from people

ex.en: Have you ever served as a witness in a court case?
ex.zh: 你曾在法庭案件中當過證人嗎？

ex.en: The police are looking for witnesses to the accident.
ex.zh: 警方正在尋找這起事故的目擊者。

witness.en: a person who sees an event happen, or who tells a court what they know

ex.en: He witnessed the accident.
ex.zh: 他目擊了那起意外。

ex.en: We are witnessing a major change in the industry.
ex.zh: 我們正在見證這個產業的重大變革。

witness.en: to see something happen, especially an accident or crime

ex.en: The term "qipao" is widely used in Northern China.
ex.zh: 「旗袍」這個詞在中國北方被廣泛使用。

ex.en: The underlying causes of the problem are widely known.
ex.zh: 這個問題的根本原因眾所皆知。

ex.en: Mandarin, English, and Arabic are all examples of the world's most widely spoken languages.
ex.zh: 華語、英語和阿拉伯語都是世界上使用最廣泛的語言。

widely.en: in or to many places or by many people

ex.en: Prices vary widely from store to store.
ex.zh: 各家店的價格差異很大。

ex.en: Opinions differ widely on this issue.
ex.zh: 大家對這個問題的看法差異很大。

ex.en: It is good to be a winner.
ex.zh: 當個贏家很好。

ex.en: The winner of this quarter-final match will advance to the semi-final stage.
ex.zh: 這場八強賽的勝方將晉級四強。

ex.en: The winner will receive a free trip to Japan.
ex.zh: 得獎者將獲得免費日本之旅。

winner.en: a person who gets first place or a prize in a competition

ex.en: I found a bird whose wing was severely damaged.
ex.zh: 我發現一隻翅膀受了重傷的鳥。

ex.en: Most insects have six legs and four wings.
ex.zh: 大多數昆蟲有六隻腳和四隻翅膀。

ex.en: This swallow's wing is injured.
ex.zh: 這隻燕子的翅膀受傷了。

wing.en: one of the parts of a bird or insect that it uses to fly

ex.en: The plane lost part of its wing.
ex.zh: 飛機的機翼斷了一部分。

ex.en: I'd like a window seat, but not over the wing.
ex.zh: 我想要靠窗的座位，但不要在機翼旁邊。

wing.en: one of the two flat parts on the sides of a plane that help it fly

ex.en: The new wing of the hospital opens next month.
ex.zh: 醫院的新大樓下個月啟用。

ex.en: Our office is in the east wing of the building.
ex.zh: 我們的辦公室在大樓的東側。

wing.en: a part of a large building that sticks out from the main part

ex.en: Wires are used to convey electricity.
ex.zh: 電線是用來輸送電力的。

ex.en: Is the wire live? I can tell just by touching it.
ex.zh: 這條電線有沒有電？我一摸就知道。

ex.en: The fence was made of wire.
ex.zh: 這道圍籬是用鐵絲做的。

wire.en: a long thin piece of metal, often used to carry electricity

ex.en: Please wire the money to our account by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前把款項匯到我們的帳戶。

ex.en: I wired him 500 dollars yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天匯了 500 美元給他。

wire.en: to send money directly from one bank account to another

ex.en: The electrician wired the new office.
ex.zh: 電工幫新辦公室配好了線路。

ex.en: Is the building wired for high-speed internet?
ex.zh: 這棟大樓有拉高速網路的線路嗎？

wire.en: to connect a building or machine to electric cables

ex.en: A wise man would not say such a thing.
ex.zh: 聰明人不會說這種話。

ex.en: A wise leader knows when to listen to others.
ex.zh: 有智慧的領導者知道何時該聽取別人的意見。

ex.en: She is older and wiser now.
ex.zh: 她現在年紀更大，也更有智慧了。

wise.en: able to make good decisions because of knowledge and experience

ex.en: It would be wise to book the hotel early.
ex.zh: 早點訂飯店是明智之舉。

ex.en: I don't think it's wise to quit your job now.
ex.zh: 我覺得現在辭職不太明智。

wise.en: sensible and likely to have a good result

ex.en: She wiped her wet hair with a towel.
ex.zh: 她用毛巾擦乾濕頭髮。

ex.en: Wipe the pan dry with a paper towel.
ex.zh: 用紙巾把鍋子擦乾。

ex.en: Please wipe the table after lunch.
ex.zh: 午餐後請把桌子擦乾淨。

wipe.en: to clean or dry something by rubbing it with a cloth or your hand

ex.en: They are struggling with the goal of wiping out smallpox.
ex.zh: 他們努力的目標是根除天花。

ex.en: The storm wiped out the entire harvest.
ex.zh: 暴風雨毀掉了全部收成。

ex.en: Give the screen a quick wipe.
ex.zh: 把螢幕快速擦一下。

ex.en: I always carry baby wipes in my bag.
ex.zh: 我包包裡總是帶著濕紙巾。

wipe.en: an act of cleaning something by rubbing it, or a small wet cloth used for this

ex.en: I had never seen a windmill until I visited the Netherlands.
ex.zh: 我去荷蘭之前從沒見過風車。

ex.en: In Netherlands you can see windmills wherever you go.
ex.zh: 在荷蘭，不管走到哪裡都看得到風車。

ex.en: The old windmill is now a small museum.
ex.zh: 那座舊風車現在是一間小型博物館。

windmill.en: a tall building with long blades that turn in the wind to make power

ex.en: We went window-shopping downtown on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我們星期天去市區逛街，只看不買。

ex.en: Window-shopping is free and fun.
ex.zh: 只逛不買既免費又好玩。

window-shopping.en: looking at things in shop windows without buying anything

ex.en: I don't think we'd have any chance of winning.
ex.zh: 我覺得我們沒有勝算。

ex.en: Which team won the game last night?
ex.zh: 昨晚的比賽哪隊贏了？

win.en: to be first or best in a game, race or fight

ex.en: At last, Mario managed to win the princess's love.
ex.zh: 最後，瑪利歐終於贏得了公主的芳心。

ex.en: Charms strike the sight, but merit wins the soul.
ex.zh: 魅力吸引目光，美德贏得人心。

win.en: to get something good by effort or skill

ex.en: It was cold, and in addition, it was windy.
ex.zh: 天氣很冷，而且風很大。

ex.en: It's very windy, but it's not cold.
ex.zh: 風很大，但不冷。

ex.en: I live in a rather windy area.
ex.zh: 我住的地方風滿大的。

windy.en: with a lot of strong air moving outside

ex.en: The sun rises earlier in summer than in winter.
ex.zh: 夏天的太陽比冬天早升起。

ex.en: Strawberries sell for a high price in the winter.
ex.zh: 草莓在冬天賣得很貴。

ex.en: Cold and dry, splendid sunshine, what beautiful winter weather!
ex.zh: 又冷又乾，陽光燦爛，多麼美好的冬日天氣！

winter.en: the coldest season of the year, after autumn

ex.en: When the World Wildlife Fund was founded in 1961, it took the panda as its symbol.
ex.zh: 世界自然基金會在 1961 年成立時，以熊貓作為標誌。

ex.en: During the holidays, some university students go to Africa as volunteers and help to perfect local wildlife conservation.
ex.zh: 放假時，有些大學生會去非洲當志工，協助當地的野生動物保育。

wildlife.en: animals and plants that live in nature

ex.en: The wicked witch cast a spell on the man and turned him into a bug.
ex.zh: 惡毒的巫婆在男人身上施了咒語，把他變成了一隻蟲子。

ex.en: It is wicked of you to do such things.
ex.zh: 你竟然做出那樣的事來，你還是人嗎？

ex.en: The wicked king punished anyone who disagreed with him.
ex.zh: 那個邪惡的國王懲罰任何不同意他的人。

ex.en: She is unable to withstand the pressure.
ex.zh: 她無法應付壓力。

ex.en: The old bridge cannot withstand heavy trucks.
ex.zh: 這座老橋承受不住重型卡車。

withstand.en: to stay strong against a difficult or harmful force

ex.en: Tom and Mary said they'd be willing to go.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗說他們願意去。

ex.en: Are you willing to go to the beach?
ex.zh: 海灘上你到底願意去嗎？

ex.en: You know that I'm willing to try this.
ex.zh: 你知道，我願意試試這個。

willing.en: ready and happy to do something

ex.en: Suddenly the horse began to run about wildly.
ex.zh: 馬突然狂暴地亂跑。

ex.en: The crowd cheered wildly when the band appeared.
ex.zh: 樂團出場時，群眾瘋狂歡呼。

ex.en: His heart was beating wildly.
ex.zh: 他的心臟狂跳不已。

wildly.en: in an uncontrolled and excited way

ex.en: A man whose wife is dead is called a widower.
ex.zh: 死了妻子的人叫做鰥夫。

ex.en: The widower raised his three children alone.
ex.zh: 那位鰥夫獨自撫養三個孩子。

widower.en: a man whose wife has died and who has not married again

ex.en: Her quick wit made her a popular speaker.
ex.zh: 她反應敏捷又風趣，因此是很受歡迎的講者。

ex.en: He answered every question with humor and wit.
ex.zh: 他用幽默和機智回答每個問題。

wit.en: the ability to say clever and funny things

wit.zh: 智力、頭腦（常用 at one's wit's end：束手無策）

ex.en: I was at my wit's end when I heard the news.
ex.zh: 當我聽到這個訊息時, 我束手無策。

ex.en: I lost my job and I have no money. I'm at my wit's end.
ex.zh: 我失業又沒錢。真不知該何去何從。

wit.en: the ability to think quickly and clearly

ex.en: I'm going to the bank to withdraw money.
ex.zh: 我要去銀行領錢。

ex.en: Foreign investors withdrew their money from America.
ex.zh: 外國投資人把資金從美國撤出。

withdraw.en: to take money out of a bank account

ex.en: The Soviet troops started to withdraw from Afghanistan.
ex.zh: 蘇聯軍隊開始從阿富汗撤軍了。

ex.en: You may as well withdraw from the club right away.
ex.zh: 你不如馬上退出這個社團。

withdraw.en: to move back or leave a place, group or activity

ex.en: He withdrew his hand from the table.
ex.zh: 他把手從桌上收了回來。

ex.en: She withdrew her application.
ex.zh: 她撤回了申請。

withdraw.en: to take something back or remove it

ex.en: We will pay the deposit by wire transfer.
ex.zh: 我們會用電匯支付訂金。

ex.en: International wire transfers usually take two to three days.
ex.zh: 國際電匯通常要兩到三天。

wire transfer.en: a way of sending money directly from one bank to another

ex.en: Tax withholding is shown on your pay statement.
ex.zh: 薪資單上會列出預扣稅款。

ex.en: The company handles withholding for its employees.
ex.zh: 公司負責替員工辦理扣繳。

withholding.en: money taken from someone's pay in advance to pay tax

ex.en: The electrician replaced the outdated wiring throughout the house.
ex.zh: 電工更換了整棟房子老舊的配線。

ex.en: Faulty wiring can cause a fire, so schedule an inspection.
ex.zh: 故障配線可能引發火災，請安排檢查。

wiring.en: the system of electric cables in a building or machine

ex.en: A stone cracked the windshield on the mountain road.
ex.zh: 在山路上，一顆石頭擊裂了擋風玻璃。

ex.en: Please clear the fog from the windshield before driving.
ex.zh: 開車前請先清除擋風玻璃上的霧氣。

windshield.en: the large glass window at the front of a car

ex.en: This partnership is a win-win situation for both companies.
ex.zh: 這次合作對兩家公司來說是雙贏。

ex.en: Let's find a win-win solution.
ex.zh: 我們來找一個雙贏的解決辦法吧。

win-win.en: good for everyone who is involved

ex.en: The widow lived alone in a small house near the river.
ex.zh: 那位寡婦獨自住在河邊的小房子裡。

ex.en: Neighbors often helped the elderly widow with shopping.
ex.zh: 鄰居常幫這位年長的寡婦買東西。

ex.en: They camped in the wilderness far from any town.
ex.zh: 他們在遠離任何城鎮的荒野中露營。

ex.en: The park protects a large area of wilderness.
ex.zh: 這座公園保護了一大片荒野地區。

ex.en: Measure the width of the table first.
ex.zh: 先量一下桌子的寬度。

ex.en: The river is about ten meters in width.
ex.zh: 這條河寬約十公尺。

ex.en: The room has a width of four meters.
ex.zh: 這個房間的寬度是四公尺。

ex.en: I went to the movies with my sister.
ex.zh: 我和姊姊一起去看電影。

ex.en: Would you like to have lunch with us?
ex.zh: 你要不要跟我們一起吃午餐？

ex.en: She cut the cake with a sharp knife.
ex.zh: 她用一把鋒利的刀切蛋糕。

ex.en: You can pay with cash or a credit card.
ex.zh: 你可以用現金或信用卡付款。

with.zh: 有、帶著（a girl with long hair）

ex.en: The girl with long hair is my classmate.
ex.zh: 那個留著長髮的女孩是我的同學。

ex.en: He walked into the room with a big smile.
ex.zh: 他帶著大大的笑容走進房間。

ex.en: William is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 威廉是英語系國家很常見的名字。

ex.en: William goes jogging with his dog every morning.
ex.zh: 威廉每天早上都帶著狗去慢跑。

ex.en: Our teacher called William to the front of the class.
ex.zh: 老師叫威廉到教室前面。

ex.en: Wilson is a common family name in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 威爾遜是英語國家常見的姓氏。

ex.en: Mrs. Wilson welcomed the new students to the class.
ex.zh: 威爾遜太太歡迎新同學來到班上。

ex.en: Williams is a common family name in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 威廉姆斯是英語國家常見的姓氏。

ex.en: Ms. Williams answered the questions after class.
ex.zh: 威廉姆斯女士在下課後回答了問題。

ex.en: He opened the little wicket in the big gate.
ex.zh: 他打開大門上的那扇小門。

ex.en: She bought the tickets at the wicket.
ex.zh: 她在售票窗口買了票。

wimbledon.zh: 溫布頓（倫敦的一個地區，以網球賽聞名）

ex.en: Wimbledon is a district in the southwest of London.
ex.zh: 溫布頓是倫敦西南部的一個地區。

ex.en: The Wimbledon tennis tournament is held every summer.
ex.zh: 溫布頓網球錦標賽每年夏天舉行。

ex.en: She dreams of playing on the grass courts at Wimbledon.
ex.zh: 她夢想在溫布頓的草地球場上比賽。

willie.zh: 威利（男子名，William 的暱稱）

ex.en: Willie fixed our bike chain in just five minutes.
ex.zh: 威利五分鐘就把我們的腳踏車鏈條修好了。

ex.en: Everyone at the party was happy to see Willie again.
ex.zh: 派對上每個人都很高興再次見到威利。

ex.en: In the story, a witch lives deep in the forest.
ex.zh: 故事裡，有個女巫住在森林深處。

ex.en: She dressed up as a witch for Halloween.
ex.zh: 她在萬聖節打扮成女巫。

ex.en: The witch stirred her pot and sang a strange song.
ex.zh: 女巫攪拌著她的鍋子，唱著一首奇怪的歌。

ex.en: The winning team received a gold cup.
ex.zh: 獲勝的隊伍得到了一座金盃。

ex.en: He scored the winning goal in the last minute.
ex.zh: 他在最後一分鐘踢進了致勝的一球。

ex.en: She greeted the guests with a winning smile.
ex.zh: 她用迷人的笑容迎接客人。

ex.en: He has a winning way with children.
ex.zh: 他很有一套，孩子們都喜歡他。

ex.en: Windsor is a town west of London, and Windsor Castle stands there.
ex.zh: 溫莎是倫敦西邊的城鎮，溫莎城堡就坐落在那裡。

ex.en: Many tourists take a day trip from London to Windsor.
ex.zh: 許多遊客從倫敦出發，到溫莎一日遊。

ex.en: Winchester is an old city in the south of England.
ex.zh: 溫徹斯特是英格蘭南部的一座古城。

ex.en: We spent a weekend visiting the cathedral in Winchester.
ex.zh: 我們花了一個週末參觀溫徹斯特的大教堂。

ex.en: The knight wielded a heavy sword.
ex.zh: 騎士揮舞著一把沉重的劍。

ex.en: She wielded the axe with surprising skill.
ex.zh: 她以驚人的技巧使用著斧頭。

ex.en: The manager wields a lot of influence in the company.
ex.zh: 那位經理在公司裡握有很大的影響力。

ex.en: Few leaders wield real power in this organization.
ex.zh: 這個組織裡很少有領導者真正掌握權力。

ex.en: We drove along a narrow, winding road.
ex.zh: 我們沿著一條狹窄蜿蜒的路開車。

ex.en: A winding river runs through the valley.
ex.zh: 一條蜿蜒的河流穿過山谷。

winding.zh: 纏繞；上發條（wind 的現在分詞）

ex.en: She is winding the wool into a ball.
ex.zh: 她正把毛線繞成一團。

ex.en: He is winding the old clock before bed.
ex.zh: 他睡前正在給那座老鐘上發條。

ex.en: He winked at me to show he was joking.
ex.zh: 他對我眨了眨眼，表示他在開玩笑。

ex.en: The little girl winked at her grandfather across the room.
ex.zh: 小女孩隔著房間對爺爺眨眼。

ex.en: She gave me a quick wink and left.
ex.zh: 她對我快速眨了一下眼就離開了。

ex.en: I didn't sleep a wink last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚完全沒睡。

ex.en: The winger sprinted down the left side and crossed the ball.
ex.zh: 邊鋒沿左路衝刺並傳出了球。

ex.en: Our team needs a fast winger.
ex.zh: 我們隊需要一位速度快的邊鋒。

ex.en: She willingly helped us move to the new house.
ex.zh: 她樂意幫我們搬到新家。

ex.en: No one would willingly give up such a chance.
ex.zh: 沒有人會心甘情願放棄這樣的機會。

ex.en: She wore a long blond wig for the costume party.
ex.zh: 她戴著一頂金色長假髮去參加變裝派對。

ex.en: The judge's white wig looked old-fashioned.
ex.zh: 法官的白色假髮看起來很古板。

ex.en: He lost his hair and now wears a wig.
ex.zh: 他掉光了頭髮，現在戴假髮。

ex.en: He winced when the nurse touched his sore arm.
ex.zh: 護理師碰到他疼痛的手臂時，他痛得縮了一下。

ex.en: I winced at the sound of the chalk on the board.
ex.zh: 我聽到粉筆刮黑板的聲音就忍不住皺眉縮了一下。

ex.en: She gave a wince of pain as she stood up.
ex.zh: 她站起來時痛得皺了一下眉。

ex.en: With a wince, he remembered his embarrassing mistake.
ex.zh: 他想起自己那個尷尬的錯誤，不禁縮了一下身子。

ex.en: A willow tree grows beside the river.
ex.zh: 河邊長著一棵柳樹。

ex.en: The basket was woven from thin willow branches.
ex.zh: 這個籃子是用細柳枝編成的。

ex.en: They sat on a willow bench in the garden.
ex.zh: 他們坐在花園裡一張柳木長椅上。

ex.en: The willow furniture on the porch looks light and elegant.
ex.zh: 門廊上的柳木家具看起來輕盈優雅。

ex.en: A stone hit the windscreen and left a small crack.
ex.zh: 一顆石頭打中擋風玻璃，留下一道小裂痕。

ex.en: Turn on the wipers to clean the windscreen.
ex.zh: 打開雨刷把擋風玻璃刷乾淨。

ex.en: The wizard waved his wand and the door opened.
ex.zh: 巫師揮了揮魔杖，門就開了。

ex.en: My son loves stories about a young wizard and his school.
ex.zh: 我兒子很愛看小巫師和他學校的故事。

ex.en: She is a wizard with numbers and fixes every budget.
ex.zh: 她是數字高手，能搞定所有預算。

ex.en: Our neighbor is a computer wizard who helps everyone.
ex.zh: 我們的鄰居是電腦高手，大家都找他幫忙。

ex.en: My grandfather is a witty man who loves wordplay.
ex.zh: 我爺爺是個機智風趣、愛玩文字遊戲的人。

ex.en: She wrote a witty reply that made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 她寫了一則機智的回覆，讓大家都笑了。

ex.en: The flowers began to wilt in the heat.
ex.zh: 花朵在高溫下開始枯萎。

ex.en: Lettuce will wilt if you leave it out in the sun.
ex.zh: 萵苣如果放在太陽下就會蔫掉。

ex.en: The students started to wilt after a long afternoon.
ex.zh: 漫長的下午之後，學生們開始無精打采。

ex.en: We toured a small winery and tasted several red wines.
ex.zh: 我們參觀了一家小酒莊，品嚐了幾種紅酒。

ex.en: The winery produces thousands of bottles every year.
ex.zh: 這家葡萄酒廠每年生產數千瓶酒。

ex.en: The puppy wiggled with joy when I came home.
ex.zh: 我回到家時，小狗開心得扭來扭去。

ex.en: Try to wiggle your toes in the sand.
ex.zh: 試著在沙子裡動動你的腳趾。

ex.en: With a little wiggle, the loose tooth came out.
ex.zh: 輕輕晃動一下，鬆動的牙就掉了。

ex.en: The dog gave a happy wiggle of its tail.
ex.zh: 狗開心地搖了搖尾巴。

ex.en: The hillside was covered with colorful wildflowers in spring.
ex.zh: 春天時山坡上開滿了五顏六色的野花。

ex.en: She picked a wildflower and put it in her hair.
ex.zh: 她摘了一朵野花別在頭髮上。

ex.en: The basket is made of wicker.
ex.zh: 這個籃子是柳條編成的。

ex.en: We sat on wicker chairs on the porch.
ex.zh: 我們坐在門廊的藤椅上。

ex.en: She was widowed at the age of forty.
ex.zh: 她四十歲時喪偶。

ex.en: My widowed grandmother lives alone near the park.
ex.zh: 我守寡的奶奶獨自住在公園附近。

ex.en: The flowers withered because nobody watered them.
ex.zh: 沒人澆水，花就枯萎了。

ex.en: Without rain, the crops will wither in the fields.
ex.zh: 沒有雨水，田裡的作物會枯死。

ex.en: Her hopes slowly withered after the long wait.
ex.zh: 漫長的等待後，她的希望慢慢消逝。

ex.en: Support for the old plan withered within weeks.
ex.zh: 對舊計畫的支持幾週內就消退了。

ex.en: The lottery prize was a sudden windfall for the family.
ex.zh: 彩券獎金對這家人來說是一筆意外之財。

ex.en: They used the windfall to pay off their debts.
ex.zh: 他們用這筆橫財還清了債務。

ex.en: Oscar Wilde was an Irish writer and playwright.
ex.zh: 奧斯卡．王爾德是愛爾蘭作家兼劇作家。

ex.en: Wilde wrote the play The Importance of Being Earnest.
ex.zh: 王爾德寫了劇本《不可兒戲》。

ex.en: A wildfire spread across the dry hills.
ex.zh: 一場野火蔓延過乾燥的山丘。

ex.en: Firefighters worked all night to control the wildfire.
ex.zh: 消防員整夜奮戰以控制野火。

wildfire.zh: 像野火般迅速蔓延（spread like wildfire）

ex.en: The rumor spread like wildfire through the school.
ex.zh: 這個謠言像野火一樣在學校裡迅速傳開。

ex.en: News of the sale spread like wildfire online.
ex.zh: 特價的消息在網路上迅速傳開。

ex.en: In the old story, the villagers feared witchcraft.
ex.zh: 在古老的故事裡，村民們害怕巫術。

ex.en: The museum has an exhibition on witchcraft in history.
ex.zh: 博物館有一場關於歷史上巫術的展覽。

ex.en: The winged horse is a famous figure in Greek myths.
ex.zh: 有翅膀的馬是希臘神話中有名的角色。

ex.en: A winged insect landed on the window.
ex.zh: 一隻有翅膀的昆蟲停在窗戶上。

ex.en: A wisp of smoke rose from the chimney.
ex.zh: 一縷輕煙從煙囪升起。

ex.en: A wisp of hair fell across her face.
ex.zh: 一綹頭髮垂在她的臉上。

ex.en: He was a small, wiry man who could run for hours.
ex.zh: 他是個瘦小結實的男人，可以跑上好幾個小時。

ex.en: The dog has a wiry coat that needs regular brushing.
ex.zh: 這隻狗的毛粗硬，需要定期梳理。

ex.en: Windsurfing is popular at this beach when the wind is strong.
ex.zh: 風大的時候，這片海灘很受風帆衝浪愛好者歡迎。

ex.en: He took up windsurfing last summer and loves it.
ex.zh: 他去年夏天開始玩風帆衝浪，非常喜歡。

widening.zh: 擴大、加寬（widen 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The city is widening the road to reduce traffic jams.
ex.zh: 市政府正在拓寬這條路以減少塞車。

ex.en: She smiled, her eyes widening with surprise.
ex.zh: 她笑了，驚訝得眼睛睜大。

ex.en: The widening of the gap between rich and poor worries many people.
ex.zh: 貧富差距的擴大讓許多人憂心。

ex.en: Residents welcomed the widening of the bridge.
ex.zh: 居民歡迎這座橋的拓寬工程。

ex.en: The child's wilful refusal to listen annoyed his mother.
ex.zh: 孩子任性不聽話，惹惱了他母親。

ex.en: The court found him guilty of wilful damage.
ex.zh: 法院認定他蓄意毀損。

ex.en: She ignored the rules with willful disregard.
ex.zh: 她故意無視規定。

ex.en: He is a willful child who hates being told what to do.
ex.zh: 他是個任性的孩子，討厭被人指使。

ex.en: Thinking he will change is just wishful thinking.
ex.zh: 以為他會改變只是一廂情願。

ex.en: It may be wishful to expect the rain to stop soon.
ex.zh: 期待雨很快停可能只是一廂情願。

ex.en: She gave the shop window a wishful look.
ex.zh: 她用渴望的眼神看著櫥窗。

ex.en: The children had wishful faces as the ice cream truck passed.
ex.zh: 冰淇淋車經過時，孩子們露出渴望的表情。

ex.en: The cat sat on the windowsill watching the rain.
ex.zh: 貓坐在窗臺上看著雨。

ex.en: She keeps small plants on the kitchen windowsill.
ex.zh: 她在廚房窗臺上擺了小盆栽。

ex.en: She looked wistfully at the old photographs.
ex.zh: 她惆悵地望著那些舊照片。

ex.en: He smiled wistfully as he remembered his school days.
ex.zh: 他想起求學時光，帶著些許惆悵微笑。

ex.en: She donated her winnings to a local charity.
ex.zh: 她把贏得的獎金捐給了當地的慈善機構。

ex.en: He spent all his winnings on a new car.
ex.zh: 他把贏來的錢全花在買新車上。

ex.en: Turn on the wipers because it is raining hard.
ex.zh: 雨下得很大，把雨刷打開。

ex.en: The windshield wiper left a long line on the glass.
ex.zh: 擋風玻璃的雨刷在玻璃上留下一道長長的痕跡。

ex.en: She gave a wistful smile as she looked at old photos.
ex.zh: 她看著舊照片，露出一抹惆悵的微笑。

ex.en: He felt wistful about his childhood summers.
ex.zh: 他對童年的夏天感到惆悵懷念。

ex.en: The story shows the wickedness of the evil queen.
ex.zh: 這個故事描寫了邪惡皇后的惡毒。

ex.en: Nobody could understand the wickedness of his plan.
ex.zh: 沒有人能理解他那計畫有多麼邪惡。

ex.en: Lawyers help families write their wills.
ex.zh: 律師協助家庭撰寫遺囑。

ex.en: Both of their wills were kept in a safe.
ex.zh: 他們兩人的遺囑都放在保險箱裡。

ex.en: Strong wills can overcome many difficulties.
ex.zh: 堅強的意志能克服許多困難。

ex.en: Two stubborn wills clashed over the small decision.
ex.zh: 兩個固執的意志為了那件小事而衝突。

ex.en: The windowless room felt cold and small.
ex.zh: 那間沒有窗的房間感覺又冷又小。

ex.en: He worked all day in a windowless office.
ex.zh: 他整天都在沒有窗戶的辦公室裡工作。

ex.en: Don't be such a wimp; it's only a small shot.
ex.zh: 別這麼膽小，只是打一針小針而已。

ex.en: He felt like a wimp for running away from the dog.
ex.zh: 他因為被狗嚇跑而覺得自己很孬。

ex.en: The old man had a few wispy white hairs on his head.
ex.zh: 老先生頭上只有幾根稀疏的白髮。

ex.en: Wispy clouds floated across the blue sky.
ex.zh: 一縷縷細薄的雲飄過藍天。

ex.en: The withering flowers drooped in the hot sun.
ex.zh: 凋萎的花朵在烈日下垂著頭。

ex.en: She gave him a withering look after his rude joke.
ex.zh: 他說了無禮的笑話後，她給了他一個凌厲的眼神。

ex.en: Hunters need a licence to shoot wildfowl in this region.
ex.zh: 在這個地區獵捕獵鳥需要有執照。

ex.en: The marsh is a winter home for thousands of wildfowl.
ex.zh: 這片沼澤是成千上萬隻水禽的過冬棲地。

ex.en: They used a winch to pull the boat onto the trailer.
ex.zh: 他們用絞車把船拉上拖車。

ex.en: The truck has a winch on the front for emergencies.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車前面裝有絞盤以備緊急使用。

ex.en: The crew winched the car out of the mud.
ex.zh: 工作人員用絞車把車從泥巴裡拉出來。

ex.en: They winched the heavy box up to the roof.
ex.zh: 他們用絞盤把沉重的箱子吊到屋頂。

ex.en: This is a wired keyboard, so it needs a cable.
ex.zh: 這是有線鍵盤，所以需要接線。

ex.en: The old house was not wired for modern appliances.
ex.zh: 這棟老房子的電路沒有為現代電器設計。

ex.en: I'm too wired from coffee to sleep.
ex.zh: 我喝了咖啡太亢奮，睡不著。

ex.en: The kids were wired after the party.
ex.zh: 孩子們參加完派對後都很亢奮。

wired.zh: 匯款；接電線（wire 的過去式）

ex.en: She wired the money to her brother this morning.
ex.zh: 她今天早上把錢電匯給了哥哥。

ex.en: The electrician wired the new lights in an hour.
ex.zh: 電工一小時就把新燈具接好了線。

ex.en: Trim the wick before you light the candle.
ex.zh: 點蠟燭之前先把燈芯剪短。

ex.en: The oil lamp's wick was almost burned out.
ex.zh: 油燈的燈芯幾乎燒光了。

ex.en: He willfully ignored the rules and was fined.
ex.zh: 他故意無視規定而被罰款。

ex.en: The company was accused of willfully hiding the problem.
ex.zh: 公司被指控故意隱瞞這個問題。

ex.en: The child willfully refused to put on his coat.
ex.zh: 那孩子任性地不肯穿外套。

ex.en: She willfully turned away and would not listen.
ex.zh: 她固執地轉過身去，不肯聽。

ex.en: The wily fox tricked the crow out of its cheese.
ex.zh: 狡猾的狐狸騙走了烏鴉的起司。

ex.en: He is a wily businessman who always gets a good deal.
ex.zh: 他是個精明狡猾的生意人，總能談到好價錢。

ex.en: The wily old man found a clever way out of trouble.
ex.zh: 那位老奸巨猾的老人想出一個巧妙的辦法脫身。

ex.en: We walked along a windswept beach in the early morning.
ex.zh: 我們清晨沿著一片風大的海灘散步。

ex.en: The windswept hills had almost no trees.
ex.zh: 那些風颳的山丘幾乎沒有樹。

ex.en: Police got a court order to wiretap the suspect's phone.
ex.zh: 警方取得法院命令，竊聽嫌犯的電話。

ex.en: It is illegal to wiretap someone without permission.
ex.zh: 未經許可竊聽他人是違法的。

ex.en: The wiretap revealed the plan.
ex.zh: 這次竊聽揭露了那項計畫。

ex.en: A wiretap was placed on the office phone.
ex.zh: 辦公室的電話被裝了竊聽器。

ex.en: He wilfully ignored the warning signs.
ex.zh: 他故意無視那些警告標誌。

ex.en: The child wilfully broke the toy to annoy his sister.
ex.zh: 那孩子為了惹妹妹生氣，故意把玩具弄壞。

ex.en: I packed a light windbreaker for the windy beach.
ex.zh: 我帶了一件輕便的防風外套去風大的海邊。

ex.en: He put on his windbreaker before going for a run.
ex.zh: 他穿上防風外套才出去跑步。

ex.en: She walked in from the beach with windblown hair.
ex.zh: 她頂著被風吹亂的頭髮從海灘走進來。

ex.en: The windblown sand covered the road overnight.
ex.zh: 被風吹起的沙子一夜之間蓋住了道路。

ex.en: A wintry wind blew across the empty field.
ex.zh: 一陣寒冷的風吹過空曠的田野。

ex.en: We spent a wintry afternoon by the fire.
ex.zh: 我們在火爐邊度過了一個寒冷的冬日午後。

wiki.zh: 維基（可共同編輯的網站）

ex.en: Our team keeps its notes on a wiki.
ex.zh: 我們團隊把筆記放在一個維基網站上。

ex.en: Anyone in the class can edit the wiki.
ex.zh: 班上任何人都可以編輯這個維基。

ex.en: It takes willpower to get up early every day.
ex.zh: 每天早起需要意志力。

ex.en: She quit smoking through sheer willpower.
ex.zh: 她全憑意志力戒了菸。

ex.en: I love the wildness of the mountains.
ex.zh: 我喜愛山林的野性之美。

ex.en: The wildness of the coast attracts many hikers.
ex.zh: 海岸荒野的氣息吸引了許多登山客。

ex.en: The fox used every wile to escape the hunters.
ex.zh: 狐狸用盡各種詭計想擺脫獵人。

ex.en: She got the job through charm and a few clever wiles.
ex.zh: 她靠魅力和一些小聰明得到了這份工作。

ex.en: He tried to wile her into signing the contract.
ex.zh: 他想哄騙她簽下那份合約。

ex.en: We wiled away the afternoon playing cards.
ex.zh: 我們玩牌消磨了一個下午。

ex.en: In wintertime the whole village is covered in snow.
ex.zh: 到了冬天，整個村莊都覆蓋著白雪。

ex.en: I love drinking hot soup in wintertime.
ex.zh: 我喜歡在冬天喝熱湯。

ex.en: Rain tapped softly against the windowpane.
ex.zh: 雨輕輕敲打著窗玻璃。

ex.en: A ball broke the windowpane and scattered glass on the floor.
ex.zh: 一顆球打破了窗玻璃，碎片散落一地。
